mechanism: Tenofovir may increase fluphenazine levels through renal competition and potential CYP3A4 inhibition, while fluphenazine's anticholinergic effects may reduce tenofovir absorption; both drugs have potential nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess for fluphenazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis), and ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antiretroviral if renal impairment develops.
